question: URKE is related to ZWPJ in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, OLEY is related to TQJD. To which of the given options is DATN related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, URKE is related to ZWPJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60a4d3756765a0555ff950095a990aa9915d51e3b61929961f4bf68291aedd73.png] 

For, OLEY is related to TQJD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5613d6021dcb6e00f403bfea49af21454709903207755163dbb388e63d1a8efc.png] 

Similarly, for **DATN**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/230429a8ddd07b2bf944a9868c76dcaac7ee9765b20c997bdd42fcce26e6f9a4.png] 

So, DATN will be related to **IFYS.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
